roles.name: Research
roles.description: Map the codebase, find the relevant files and produce an executable plan with risks.

roles.name: Coding
roles.description: Implement the plan as the smallest coherent diff, then explain what changed.

roles.name: Coding Review
roles.description: Review the working-tree diff without editing anything, and return a gate verdict.

roles.name: Debug
roles.description: Find the root cause of a failed gate and fix it, then say what the real cause was.

roles.name: Test
roles.description: Run the repository's own checks and report the result as a gate verdict.

roles.name: Flash
roles.description: Produce a firmware flashing plan for an embedded target. Never executes it.
